Subject: BrightPath — post-demo recap & MAP (please confirm owners/dates)

Hi Tom / Lily,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) covering the evaluation milestones, owners, and target dates. High level recap: 

- Outcome: Validate Redwood's latency and cost improvements for BrightPath's realtime summarization flow
- Key success criteria: 95th percentile latency < 300ms for 1024-token requests; token cost < $0.0015 per token for steady-state throughput
- Scope: Hosted API proof-of-concept + integration test harness for privacy-preserving logs

What I need from you to keep momentum:
1) Confirm owners for each row in the attached MAP (we've suggested CG for BrightPath engineering and Lily for project sponsor)
2) Confirm target dates (we've proposed a 4-week evaluation starting 2026-08-02)
3) Any regulatory or procurement blockers we should factor in now

Attachment: BrightPath_MAP_20260712.xlsx (MAP draft - editable)

If it helps, I can convert the MAP into a one-page mutual action slide for your execs. Happy to schedule a quick 20-min sync with Rishi (SE) to walk through integration tasks.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
